description: Output routing (dev-rad1): where the synthesized sound goes - board (native exciter channels), speakers (the per-mode radiance mix on the speaker outputs, exciters silent) or dual (both) - in a mono or stereo layout; plus the per-mode speaker radiance factors (also plain mode fields radiance_mono / radiance_stereo via param.set).

commands.name: output.get_mode
commands.title: Read the output routing
commands.description: GET /output_routing: target (board|speakers|dual), layout (mono|stereo), which combinations the loaded preset can play (available: null = OK, else the reason), speaker_channels (dedicated, from model_parameters.radiance) and speaker_outputs (PIANOID_SPEAKER_OUTPUTS, 0-based), the live asio_map / asio_mirrors, the radiance basis / trim_db / source / provisional flag and, when a speaker mix plays, its overall gain (energy-matched to the exciter channels, incl. the trim).

commands.name: output.set_mode
commands.title: Switch the output routing
commands.description: POST /output_routing {target?, layout?}: live switch (next cycle, no preset reload). board = the preset's exciter rows; speakers = channel(s) carrying sum_m g*r[m]*q_m to the speaker outputs, every exciter channel silent; dual = both (needs dedicated speaker channels in the preset). mono = the same signal on both speakers; stereo = radiance_stereo L/R (L = R = mono until measured). 409 {code} when the preset / driver cannot play it (state unchanged). Hard confirm: it moves the sound between the exciters and the speakers.

commands.name: radiance.import
commands.title: Import per-mode speaker radiance factors
commands.description: POST /radiance/import: one factor per mode, in mode order, for ALL modes, written as ONE undoable mode edit. mono = linear gains >= 0, or mono_db = dB values re reference_db (default: their median, so the median mode gets 1.0); stereo = optional [[L, R] x num_modes] (absent = L = R = mono). Optional config written with it: basis (absolute = speaker drive per unit engine mode signal; board_motion = per unit board motion, multiplied by the native exciter-row RMS), source (provenance, e.g. a rig run), provisional (true for a single mic position). The assistant's radiance_sweep_pos2b.json coefA_mode_db is board_motion + provisional.

commands.name: radiance.config
commands.title: Set the speaker radiance config
commands.description: POST /radiance/config: the preset's model_parameters.radiance (saved with the preset): basis (absolute | board_motion), trim_db (overall speaker level after the energy match; default -3 dB headroom), speaker_channels ([c] or [cL, cR]: output channels built for the speakers; needed for dual), source, provisional. Validated against the live routing; the speaker rows re-upload at once when a speaker mix plays. Not undoable (re-set it instead).

commands.name: radiance.from_frf
commands.title: Measure speaker radiance from a rig FRF
commands.description: POST /radiance/from_frf: the MEASURED absolute factors r[m] (speaker drive per unit engine mode signal, basis absolute) from one mic position: r[m] = sqrt(<|sum_c W[c,m] H_mic<-E_c(f)|^2> / <|H_mic<-speaker(f)|^2>) over a band_octaves band (default 1/3) around the LIVE mode frequency, W = the live native exciter rows. frf_path = the frf/frf.npz of a modal.rig_capture run with every exciter AND the speakers as references (modal.rig_process step frf); exciters = the FRF refs of the exciter channels in channel order (default E1..En); speakers default [SPKL, SPKR]; layout mono (speakers fed together: H_L + H_R), L or R (one speaker -> radiance_stereo side). apply=true writes them as ONE undoable mode edit and sets basis absolute + provenance (provisional default true: one mic position; average several positions by importing the power-mean). Modes with no exciter coupling get 0 (silent on the board too).
